_comment: Roster of TRANSCRIPT-READY personal-finance podcasts mined weekly by podcast-pain-pass-auto. Only shows whose RSS feed carries <podcast:transcript> tags can be auto-mined (no speech-to-text). Every feed below was verified on 2026-07-21 to contain a real <podcast:transcript url=...> element. To add a show: curl its feed and grep for '<podcast:transcript' before adding it. NOTE: the big Megaphone/Simplecast shows (NerdWallet Smart Money, Ramsey Show, BiggerPockets Money, Money Guy Show, etc.) do NOT embed transcript tags and cannot be mined here. 'vertical' is just a label carried through to the brief; the mined THEME (see mine_pain.py) drives the hub route.
